## [CN]导出配置文件：export-tabbar-configurations.py
## [EN]Export configuration files: export-tabbar-configurations.py

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 网络配置可能失败或被篡改，最稳妥的做法是随 App 打包一份本地配置作为兜底。这个脚本把你已经写在代码中的 TabBar 配置（`tabBarItemsAttributes`、子控制器类、context、样式、内边距、标题偏移）导出为配置文件，无需手写。 | A downloaded configuration can fail or be tampered with; the safest setup ships a local configuration in the app as a fallback. This script exports the tab bar configuration you already wrote in code (`tabBarItemsAttributes`, view controller classes, context, style, insets, title offset) to configuration files, so you do not write them by hand. |

### [CN]快速开始
### [EN]Quick start

```sh
# Your own source file, as YAML, printed. 你自己的源文件，输出 YAML 到终端。
python3 scripts/export-tabbar-configurations.py --stdout --format yaml path/to/MainTabBarController.m

# Written next to it: path/to/Configurations/MainTabBarController.json and .yaml (the default formats).
# 写入文件：path/to/Configurations/MainTabBarController.json 与 .yaml（默认格式）。
python3 scripts/export-tabbar-configurations.py path/to/MainTabBarController.m

# Every format, into a folder of your choice. 所有格式，写入指定目录。
python3 scripts/export-tabbar-configurations.py --format all --output MyApp/Resources/TabBar path/to/MainTabBarController.swift

# A whole folder (every .m / .swift that defines tab attributes). 整个目录（所有定义了 Tab 属性的 .m / .swift）。
python3 scripts/export-tabbar-configurations.py --format json MyApp/

# Without arguments: every Example*/ of this repository. 不带参数：本仓库的所有 Example*/。
python3 scripts/export-tabbar-configurations.py
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 然后把生成的文件加入 App target（Copy Bundle Resources），在代码中读取，并在网络配置失败时使用它（见下方“推荐用法”）。 | Then add the generated file to the app target (Copy Bundle Resources), read it in code, and use it when the downloaded configuration fails (see "Recommended setup" below). |

### [CN]参数
### [EN]Options

| 参数 Option | 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `paths` | 源文件或目录，可以有多个；默认为本仓库的所有 `Example*/` | Source files or folders, several allowed; default: every `Example*/` of this repository |
| `--format` | 逗号分隔的格式，或 `all`；默认 `json,yaml` | Comma-separated formats, or `all`; default `json,yaml` |
| `--output DIR` | 输出目录；默认为每个 Example（或源文件所在目录）下的 `Configurations/` | Output folder; default: `Configurations/` in each Example (or next to the source file) |
| `--stdout` | 输出到终端而不写文件（二进制格式只显示大小） | Print instead of writing files (binary formats show their size only) |
| `--check` | 不写文件；有文件过期时返回 1，可用于 CI | Write nothing; exit 1 when a file is out of date, for CI |

| `--format` | 文件 File | 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `json` | `.json` | JSON | JSON |
| `json5` | `.json5` | 不加引号的键、单引号、尾逗号 | Unquoted keys, single quotes, trailing commas |
| `plist` / `binary.plist` | `.plist` / `.binary.plist` | XML / 二进制属性列表 | XML / binary property list |
| `yaml` | `.yaml` | YAML 块样式 | YAML block style |
| `toml` | `.toml` | 每个 Tab 一个 `[[CYLTabBarControllerTabBarItemsAttributes]]` | One `[[CYLTabBarControllerTabBarItemsAttributes]]` per tab |
| `ini` / `properties` / `env` | `.ini` / `.properties` / `.env` | 点分隔路径（.env 用 `__`），Tab 用数字表示 | Dotted paths (`__` in .env), numbers for the tabs |
| `xml` | `.xml` | 元素即键，`<item>` 组成列表 | Elements are keys, `<item>` makes a list |
| `textproto` / `binpb` | `.textproto` / `.binpb` | Protobuf 文本 / 二进制（`cyl_tabbar_configuration.proto`） | Protobuf text / binary (`cyl_tabbar_configuration.proto`) |

### [CN]能读取哪些写法
### [EN]What it reads

| 代码中的写法 In code | 文件中的值 In the file |
|:---|:---|
| `@{ CYLTabBarItemTitle : @"Home", ... }`、Swift `[CYLTabBarItemTitle: "Home", ...]` | 每个键原样写入 / every key as is |
| `NSArray *a = @[ first, second ]`、`[tabHome, tabMe]`、`@[ @{...}, @{...} ]` | Tab 的顺序 / the order of the tabs |
| `CYLLocalizedString(@"首页")`、`NSLocalizedString(@"首页", nil)` | `首页`（本地化 key / the localization key） |
| `[UIImage imageNamed:@"home"]`、`UIImage(named: "home")` | `home` |
| `[UIImage systemImageNamed:@"house"]`、`UIImage(systemName: "house")` | `system:house` |
| `[NSValue valueWithUIOffset:UIOffsetMake(0, -3)]`、`NSValue(uiOffset: UIOffset(horizontal: 0, vertical: -3))` | `{0, -3}`（也支持 `-25/2` 这样的字面量算式 / literal arithmetic such as `-25/2` too） |
| `UIEdgeInsetsMake(...)`、`CGSizeMake(...)` 的 NSValue | `{t, l, b, r}`、`{w, h}` |
| `[[NSBundle mainBundle] pathForResource:@"a" ofType:@"json"]`、`[NSURL fileURLWithPath:...]`、`Bundle.main.url(forResource:withExtension:)` | `a.json` |
| `[NSURL URLWithString:@"https://..."]`、`URL(string: "https://...")!` | `https://...` |
| `UIColor(white: 0.78, alpha: 1)`、`[UIColor colorWithRed:...]` | `#C7C7C7FF` |
| `CYLLocalizedTabBarItemsAttributes(titles, images, selectedImages, darkImages)` | 每个 Tab 的标题与图片 / each tab's title and images |
| `CYLTabBarItemsAttributesAddingLottieFiles(items, names, nil)` | `CYLTabBarLottieFilePath`，存在 `_dark.json` 时加 `CYLTabBarLottieDarkFilePath` / plus the dark file when `_dark.json` exists |
| `["A", "B"].map { layer in ["\(layer)_Normal.**.Color": UIColor(...)] }` | 每个 Tab 的 `CYLTabBarLottieDarkColors` |
| `[[HomeViewController alloc] init]`、`HomeViewController()`、`UINavigationController(rootViewController:)` | `CYLTabBarItemViewControllerClass`（数量与 Tab 一致时）、`CYLTabBarControllerNavigationControllerClass` |
| `context:@"Home"`、`styleType = CYLTabBarStyleTypeLiquidGlass`、`tabBarStyleType = .flatDesign`、`titlePositionAdjustment = UIOffsetMake(...)` | 对应的顶层键 / the matching top-level keys |

### [CN]报告与限制
### [EN]Report and limits

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 每个源文件输出一行结果和一份报告。只在运行时才有的值（变量、枚举、方法调用、计算属性）无法从源码读取：不会写入，并在报告中说明，因此文件只会不完整，不会出错。例如 `- CYLTabBarItemTitle = module.title: only known at runtime; left out`。 | Each source file prints one line and a report. Values that only exist at runtime (variables, enums, method calls, computed properties) cannot be read from the source: they are left out and reported, so a file can be incomplete, never wrong. For example `- CYLTabBarItemTitle = module.title: only known at runtime; left out`. |
| 所有 Tab 都在运行时生成时（如 `Example-Swift-SwiftManager-FlatDesign`），脚本报告 “the tabs are built at runtime” 且不生成文件。 | When every tab is built at runtime (e.g. `Example-Swift-SwiftManager-FlatDesign`), the script reports "the tabs are built at runtime" and writes no file. |
| 子控制器类只在数量与 Tab 一致时写入；否则报告并使用 `UIViewController`，可以手动补上 `CYLTabBarItemViewControllerClass`。Swift 类在运行时也会按 `模块名.类名` 查找。 | View controller classes are written only when there are as many as tabs; otherwise the report says so and the tabs use `UIViewController`: add `CYLTabBarItemViewControllerClass` by hand. Swift classes are also looked up as `Module.Name` at runtime. |
| 标题写入的是本地化 key（如 `首页`）：文件中的标题不会自动本地化，需要多语言时为每种语言准备一个文件，或在读取后替换标题。 | Titles are written as their localization keys (e.g. `首页`): titles in a file are not localized automatically; for several languages, ship one file per language or replace the titles after reading. |
| PlusButton 不在配置中描述，仍按 `context` 注册。 | The plus button is not part of a configuration: it is still registered by `context`. |

### [CN]推荐用法
### [EN]Recommended setup

```objc
// 1. Export once (and after each change of the tabs): MyApp/Resources/TabBar/MainTabBarController.json
//    导出一次（Tab 改变后再次导出）。
// 2. Prefer the server's configuration, fall back to the shipped one. 优先使用服务器配置，失败时使用随 App 打包的配置。
[CYLTabBarController loadTabBarControllerWithConfigurationURL:remoteURL completion:^(CYLTabBarController *tabBarController, NSError *error) {
    if (!tabBarController) {
        tabBarController = [CYLTabBarController tabBarControllerWithConfigurationFile:@"MainTabBarController.json" error:NULL];
    }
    self.window.rootViewController = tabBarController;
}];
```

```yaml
# 3. CI: fail when the shipped file no longer matches the code. CI：随 App 打包的文件与代码不一致时失败。
- run: python3 scripts/export-tabbar-configurations.py --check --output MyApp/Resources/TabBar MyApp/MainTabBarController.m
```

## [CN]边界情况清单与评分：configuration-edge-cases.py
## [EN]Edge-case checklist and score: configuration-edge-cases.py

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| [Configuration-File.md](Configuration-File.md) 中“边界情况与评分”表格的唯一来源：每个情况的编号、描述、处理方式，以及处理它的修复轮次。某一轮的分数 = 已处理的情况 / 该轮已知的情况（部分处理计一半）；复查中发现的情况用 `found` 标出加入的轮次，因此分数可能下降。 | The only source of the "Edge cases and score" table of [Configuration-File.md](Configuration-File.md): each case's ID, description, handling, and the round of fixes that handled it. The score of a round = handled cases / cases known in that round (partly handled counts half); a case found during a review is marked with the round it was added (`found`), so a score can drop. |

```sh
python3 scripts/configuration-edge-cases.py            # the score of every round 每一轮的分数
python3 scripts/configuration-edge-cases.py --write    # regenerate the table in docs/Configuration-File.md 重新生成表格
python3 scripts/configuration-edge-cases.py --check    # exit 1 when the table is out of date 表格过期时返回 1
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 新增情况：在 `CASES` 中追加一项 `(编号, 中文情况, English case, 中文处理, English handling, dict(fixed=轮次, partial=轮次, found=轮次))`；新的一轮在 `ROUNDS` 中加入说明。然后运行 `--write`，并在 `make-fixtures.py` 中加入对应的测试文件。不要直接修改文档中的表格。 | To add a case: append `(ID, Chinese case, English case, Chinese handling, English handling, dict(fixed=round, partial=round, found=round))` to `CASES`; for a new round, add its notes to `ROUNDS`. Then run `--write`, and add a test file for it in `make-fixtures.py`. Never edit the table in the document. |

## [CN]解析器测试：configuration-tests/run-tests.sh
## [EN]Parser tests: configuration-tests/run-tests.sh

```sh
scripts/configuration-tests/run-tests.sh
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 一条命令编译并运行 `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser` 的测试，全部通过时退出码为 0，可用于 CI。共三组检查，每个文件都按扩展名与按内容识别各解析一次：①资源包中的 17 个示例文件都得到与 JSON 示例相同的字典；②`make-fixtures.py` 生成的 43 个边界情况文件（嵌套 10 万层的各种格式、损坏与截断的二进制数据、空文件、只有注释、6 MB 文件、UTF-16 / UTF-32、扩展名不符、XXE、HTML 页面、各格式的解析细节）得到预期的错误码或值；③所有 Example 以 12 种格式导出的文件都与其 JSON 版本相同。在 Linux 上还会检查解析器源码在 `-Wall -Wextra -Wshadow` 下没有警告。 | One command builds and runs the tests of `CYLTabBarConfigurationParser`; the exit status is 0 when everything passes, for CI. Three groups of checks, each file parsed once from its extension and once from its content: ① the 17 sample files of the resource bundle give the dictionary of the JSON sample; ② the 43 edge-case files of `make-fixtures.py` (100,000 levels of nesting in every format, corrupted and truncated binary data, empty files, comments only, a 6 MB file, UTF-16 / UTF-32, wrong extensions, XXE, an HTML page, parsing details of each format) give the expected error code or values; ③ every Example exported in the 12 formats gives the same dictionary as its JSON twin. On Linux it also checks that the parser's source has no warning with `-Wall -Wextra -Wshadow`. |

| 平台 Platform | 需要 Requirements | 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| macOS | Xcode 命令行工具 / Xcode command line tools | 直接用 clang 与 Foundation 编译真实源码（ARC） | Builds the real sources with clang and Foundation (ARC) |
| Linux | `sudo apt-get install clang libgnustep-base-dev gnustep-make` | GNUstep 基于 GCC 运行时，不支持对象下标与属性自动合成：`lower.py` 只改写测试用的副本，库本身不变 | GNUstep uses the GCC runtime, without object subscripting or auto-synthesized properties: `lower.py` rewrites a test copy only; the library is not changed |

| 文件 File | 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `run-tests.sh` | 生成测试文件、导出所有 Example、编译、运行 | Writes the fixtures, exports every Example, builds, runs |
| `make-fixtures.py` | 写出边界情况文件与 `manifest.json`（每个文件的预期错误码、需要相等的文件、键路径上的预期值） | Writes the edge-case files and `manifest.json` (each file's expected error code, the file it must equal, expected values at key paths) |
| `ConfigurationParserTests.m` | 测试程序（不使用 block、下标与属性，两种平台都能编译） | The test program (no blocks, subscripts or properties, so it builds on both platforms) |
| `lower.py`、`cyl_sub.h` | 仅 Linux：为 GCC 运行时改写解析器副本 | Linux only: rewrites a copy of the parser for the GCC runtime |

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 新增测试文件：在 `make-fixtures.py` 中调用 `add(文件名, 内容, 预期, 编号, equals=..., values={...})`，预期为 `'dictionary'` 或错误码（如 `TOO_DEEP`）。 | To add a test file: call `add(name, content, expected, ID, equals=..., values={...})` in `make-fixtures.py`; expected is `'dictionary'` or an error code (e.g. `TOO_DEEP`). |
| 固化测试后第一次运行就发现了第 4 轮的回归（A17：扩展名重试掩盖语法错误），已修复：这正是保留测试套件的意义。 | The first run of the kept test suite found a regression of round 4 (A17: the extension retry hid syntax errors), now fixed: that is why the suite is kept. |
